summary: Independently checked the updated diff, tests and propagation of Python exit status to the Windows installer. The three initial findings were resolved: pinned SHA256 validation and repair, mandatory warmup for a successful installation, and a nonzero installer exit if cleanup fails without disabling v4 in ordinary startup.
limitations: The reviewed pytest log contains 85 passing tests. PermissionError is simulated; actual file locking and concurrent setup/server execution were not tested.

The reviewed Linux smoke log confirms real CPU inference with ONNX Runtime 1.23.2, offline fallback and cleanup after new-model warmup. The separate online vocabulary repair was not independently witnessed.
The published Windows smoke uses the same assets, but not the Jarvis installer or microphone path. The reviewer did not rerun tests or A/B measurements.
